name: coaching-season-plan
description: Plan a season for a club, school or youth sports team: the season's aims, phases from pre-season to the final block, what is trained in each phase, weekly load, key fixtures, player development priorities and how progress is reviewed. Use when asked to plan our season, write a season plan for my under-12s, periodise training for a club side, what should we work on each month, or build a pre-season programme. Produces season aims, a phase table, a week-by-week outline, a fixture and load calendar, squad and development priorities, and review points. Distinct from deliberate-practice-plan, which is for one person's skill.
